title: DHEA-S and 17-OH progesterone
what: This blood test checks hormones made by the adrenal glands. It shows whether you have too much of the male-type hormones.
why: For irregular periods, extra body hair, acne, or trouble getting pregnant. In children, for puberty that starts too early.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in 1 to 5 days
tell_doctor: The day of your menstrual cycle. Women are often tested on day 3 to 5
If you take hormone pills or birth control
If you use steroid medicines as tablets, creams, or inhalers

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: Usually in the morning, on an empty stomach. Plain water is fine.

prepare.title: Cycle day
prepare.text: For women, the doctor usually picks a certain day of the cycle. Check it ahead.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: No alcohol, hard workouts, or stress. Do not smoke in the morning.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. Tell your doctor what you take. They will decide if anything needs to change before the test.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
The date your last period started
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tied above your elbow, and you are asked to clench your fist a few times
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick. Blood fills the tubes in a few seconds
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
The doctor will look at the result together with your other hormones
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red

faq.q: Why does the cycle day matter?
faq.a: The 17-OH progesterone level changes during the cycle. If you test on the wrong day, the result is hard to read.

faq.q: Can a child have this test?
faq.a: Yes. The doctor orders it, and a parent brings the child in the morning on an empty stomach, unless the doctor says otherwise.

reminders.text: DHEA-S and 17-OH progesterone test tomorrow. Morning, on an empty stomach, no smoking.
